text:
Review still blocks approval. Keep the complete page-consumption loops, original metadata guards, real product visits, actual workbook write, root cleanup, and accepted inputs/results. The four extract tasks still pass whole raw page-observation collections into one mapping invocation: replacing global interpretation with a global unbounded extraction does not solve request sizing. Producer observation records already expose typed kind, tag, text, group, href and role (href/role nullable). Prefer nested existing foreach over pages/records and explicit body-output field selections to build each consumer view with zero mapping inference. If learned extraction is actually necessary, explicitly declare each on complete bounded individual records and preserve one result per item; never send the full raw collection or whole manifest as shared context. Keep collection nesting/order/duplicates and every item.
Do not ask extract tasks to create snapshotComplete or observationComplete proof booleans, observed ranks absent from their source, classifications, selector hints or absent-value defaults. Completeness stays in deterministic requires against the original producer metadata; global business interpretation may classify only the necessary compact observed facts. The product decision currently receives sourceSelector although no subsequent navigation uses it: keep exact action references at their original source and select only fields that this specific decision needs. Preserve nullable href/role rather than inventing strings. Keep consent/blockage input separate from links, keep ranking global, and keep any necessary action identity through explicit existing bindings. No new permissions, public inputs, increased limits or change to business requirements. Preserve all original page/action data outside interpretation.
